title: Most biological systems consist of multiple nested selves

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Most biological systems consist of multiple nested selves

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Under Scale-Free Cognition, most biological systems consist of multiple, nested selves rather than one, each inner agent maintaining its own Self only to the extent that it restricts information flow from its neighbours.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: The Computational Boundary of a "Self": Developmental Bioelectricity Drives Multicellularity and Scale-Free Cognition

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2019, The Computational Boundary of a "Self": Developmental Bioelectricity Drives Multicellularity and Scale-Free Cognition › Multicellularity vs. Cancer: The Shifting Boundary of the Self

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: It is an essential aspect of Scale-Free Cognition that most biological systems consist of multiple, nested selves [not one, as implied by Integrated Information Theory (Tononi, 2008)].

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “The Computational Boundary of a "Self": Developmental Bioelectricity Drives Multicellularity and Scale-Free Cognition”, Frontiers in psychology (2019), doi:10.3389/fpsyg.2019.02688; section “Multicellularity vs. Cancer: The Shifting Boundary of the Self”. Scope: Multilevel biological systems (molecular networks, cells, tissues, organs, organisms, swarms)

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2019-boundary-10: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.15

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Multiscale biological organization is measurable, but the move from modules to multiple Selves is conceptual. Without a criterion that differs from the definition itself, observations cannot distinguish the claim from rival ontologies.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: One could infer nested clusters from multiscale information flow and control, but whether each cluster counts as a Self depends on the framework's chosen individuation criterion.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Nested causal modules do not uniquely imply nested selves.

No unique measurable threshold defines a Self.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.06
data existence: 0.15

discriminating power: 0.12
analysis feasibility: 0.2

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Scale-Free Cognition is defined here as requiring multiple nested selves, in contrast to a single integrated individual. Multicellular anatomy is nested whether or not each layer is an agent. Information-flow measurements can be computed and still do not decide the metaphysical labeling. The sentence is not an empirical claim.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Biological hierarchy is observable. Declaring each level a Self insofar as it restricts information from its neighbors is a stipulation; integrated-information or ordinary modularity descriptions use the same anatomy.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Nested organization can always be labeled as nested selves.

The claim states an essential feature of a theory.
